title: Tensor coherence for the specified ordinary/pro-etale pullback comparison
statement: Fix the finite purity coefficients $\Lambda$ of [def-pur-conventions]. For any scheme morphism $b:X\to Y$ and any objects $K,L$ of the unbounded ordinary etale derived category, let $F_Y,F_X$ be the exact termwise derived comparison inverse images to the pro-etale sites, and let $m_T:F_T(K\otimes^L L)\overset\sim\longrightarrow F_TK\otimes^L F_TL$ be the canonical comparison tensor isomorphism. Let $\eta_K:Lb_p^*F_YK\overset\sim\longrightarrow F_XLb_e^*K$ be exactly Dnc.pullComparison from [thm-pur-dnc-invariance], where $e,p$ distinguish the sites. Let $\tau_e,\tau_p$ be the derived inverse-image tensor constraints [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Then $F_X(\tau_e)\circ\eta_{K\otimes^L L}\circ Lb_p^*(m_Y^{-1})=m_X^{-1}\circ(\eta_K\otimes^L\eta_L)\circ\tau_p$, where $m_X$ is evaluated at $Lb_e^*K,Lb_e^*L$. This is an equality of the specified isomorphisms, with no smoothness, affineness, boundedness, constructibility or orientation hypothesis.

source.place: Step 1: canonical tensor and base-change comparisons in the compatibility assertion; the general exact-comparison calculation already proved in ComparisonOpenTensorCoherence

proof.text: Use the public comparison_tensor_compatible declaration recorded in [lem-sf-comparison-open-tensor-coherence]. Despite its surrounding module title, this declaration assumes an arbitrary scheme morphism, so it applies to b. Its comparisonTensorNatIso components equal the published comparison tensor maps by comparison_tensor_app. Expand comparisonOpenDerivedPullbackIso, replace the support comparison by the inverse inverse-image comparison using supportComparison_eq, and commute localization with inversion. Componentwise the resulting isomorphism is precisely the inverse of Dnc.pullComparison.

The existing tensor compatibility equality has the comparison tensor maps in the forward direction. Precompose with the image under pro-etale pullback of the forward tensor comparison at K,L, and postcompose with the target tensor comparison. Cancel the image of each inverse pair, and cancel the pair eta followed by its inverse. Functoriality and associativity give the stated equality with the inverse tensor comparisons. All these operations are on actual isomorphisms, for arbitrary unbounded objects.

theorem comparisonTensorPullback (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (b : X ⟶ Y)
    (K L : _root_.DerivedCategory
      (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient))) :
    let A := ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient
    let F := (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar A Y).mapDerivedCategory
    let F' := (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar A X).mapDerivedCategory
    let G := (Etale.upperStar A b).leftDerivedFunctor
    let H := (ProEtale.upperStar A b).leftDerivedFunctor
    let m := fun (B : Scheme.{u})
      (K L : _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf B.smallEtaleTopology A)) ↦
      (ProEtale.derivedTensorObjCompMapDerivedCategoryComparisonUpperStarIso A K).app L
    H.mapIso (m Y K L).symm ≪≫
        Dnc.pullComparison P b (((Etale.derivedTensor A Y).obj K).obj L) ≪≫
        F'.mapIso (Etale.leftDerivedUpperStarTensorIso A b K L) =
      ProEtale.leftDerivedUpperStarTensorIso A b (F.obj K) (F.obj L) ≪≫
        ((ProEtale.derivedTensor A X).mapIso (Dnc.pullComparison P b K)).app _ ≪≫
        ((ProEtale.derivedTensor A X).obj (F'.obj (G.obj K))).mapIso
          (Dnc.pullComparison P b L) ≪≫
        (m X (G.obj K) (G.obj L)).symm
